images.title: Hearth-sworn penitent
images.visual_aim: A burly, scarred penitent tending the hearth of a travellers' refuge, humble strength in firelight.
images.brief: A big man in a coarse undyed robe, scarred forearms bare, kneels to feed the hearth of a Still Flame refuge where travellers sleep on benches. A heavy chain-wrapped lantern hangs from his belt. Warm low firelight, deep shadows, rain at the shuttered window. His face is broad and heavy-browed, at peace.
images.direction: Medium-wide intimate view from hearth height, the kneeling man on the right facing left toward the hearth. His near hand slides a short log into the fire; his far hand rests naturally on his raised knee. Two arms and two legs with an easy legible supported kneel. Invent a broad heavy-browed, broken-nosed man in his fifties, close-cropped dark hair, stubble, one uneven ear; draw on the ordinary human sheets' varied proportions, especially H06's broad skull and H11's age rather than the glamorous H09. Thick undyed wool is matte, skin painted in broad observed warm planes. The chain-wrapped unlit belt lantern hangs clear of the log and arm. Two sleeping travellers are quiet shapes along a rear bench. Rain beads on the window opening between dark shutters. The censer-healer reference guides humble cloth and warm Still Flame material treatment, not magical ribbons or a repeated face. Peace without a theatrical smile.
